name: app.worldmonitor/docs
title: World Monitor Docs
description: Search and read World Monitor developer docs, API references, and guides.

metadata.note: First-party server card for the documentation MCP. The endpoint (url, serverUrl, remotes[].url) is the worldmonitor.app facade, which is the address agents should connect to; it is proxied to Mintlify. The card carries no tools[]: the server is anonymous, so tools/list is the authoritative inventory. Listed in /.well-known/ai-catalog.json, served at the server's own /docs/mcp/server-card, and advertised via rel="mcp-server-card" anchor="/docs/mcp" alongside the product MCP card at /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.
